thread:
incident-bot: [PAGE] Alert: p99 latency breach for customer 'Zenith' (tenant: zenith-prod) in eu-west-1. p99=9.2s (SLO=2s). Error rate stable, latency spike. Pager: @mike_oncall. Alert: https://alerts.redwood/alert/98765

mike_oncall: On it. Joining war room. Can someone pull pool utilization and tenant QPS?

tim_sre: Looking now — dedicated pool `ded-pool-eu-west-3` p95->p99 jump. GPU utilization 78%, queue depth increased x4, KV cache hit steady. I see a surge of long-context requests from zenith-prod (avg seq len 1024).

sara_ops: Customer success says payments flow degraded for some users. Carla, can you confirm user visible impact?

carla_cse: Confirmed — multiple customers reporting slow invoice generation. CS triage: ~18% of requests slow, majority from zenith-prod. They're on dedicated pool. Customer notified on support thread #12345.

mike_oncall: Quick mitigation options: 1) throttle tenant QPS, 2) scale dedicated pool (hot add nodes), 3) route non-critical routes to fallback model (smaller variant), 4) offload very long contexts to batch job. We should try 1+2 immediately.

tim_sre: Throttle is fastest. Running runbook `tenant-isolation-v2`. Command to apply per-tenant rate limit via control plane: 
```
curl -X POST https://control.redwood/api/v1/tenants/zenith-prod/limits \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"qps": 8, "burst": 16}'
```
Applying will cap offending traffic and avoid eviction.

mike_oncall: Do it. Also request 2x nodes from infra autoscaler: 
```
POST /infra/pools/ded-pool-eu-west-3/scale?add=2
```
If autoscaler slow, ops runbook `manual-hotadd` has kubectl steps.

carla_cse: We need a comms line to Zenith account team. @elaine_se can you draft a short message: cause, mitigations, ETA? They want hourly updates.

elaine_se: Drafting. Will send to account thread and mark priority-1 update. ETA for first update 15m.

incident-bot: Action taken: tenant throttle applied (qps=8) at 1798888902 by mike_oncall. Scale request submitted.

sara_ops: Monitoring metrics — p99 dropped to 3.8s after throttle, errors unchanged. Still above SLO but improving. Keep scaling.

tim_sre: Scale completed (manual hot-add) at 1798888928, pool capacity +2 GPUs. KV cache warmed for new nodes. Post-scale p99 -> 1.9s on non-throttled sample, overall p99 ~2.2s (throttled requests excluded).

mike_oncall: Good. Proposed next step: leave throttle in place for 1h while we validate, coordinate with product on longer-term quota changes. If customer requires full capacity, we need a scheduled dedicated capacity bump.

carla_cse: Zenith asks for temporary removal of throttle for a subset of VIP routes (payments). They request a canary. Need approval from SRE and on-call.

mike_oncall: We can do a route-level exception limited to 5 requests/s for payment endpoints. Use cautious canary for 10 minutes, monitor p99 and queue depth.

incident-bot: Canary deploy requested by mike_oncall at 1798888940: route exception for `POST /v1/payments/*` qps=5 for zenith-prod.

nina_oncall: Joining to pick up overnight watch. Documenting handoff: throttle qps=8 active, temporary route exception for payments qps=5 active (canary), pool scaled +2 GPUs, customer notified. I will own next 2h and will ping if regressions.

mike_oncall: Thanks @nina_oncall. Please escalate immediately if p99 > 3s or error rate increases >1%. Log pointers: /logs/tenants/zenith-prod and Grafana dashboard `incidents/zenith-eu1`

elaine_se: Sent first customer update. Will follow up hourly and coordinate any requested rollback/extension.

carla_cse: Noted. Preparing post-incident summary and SLA impact calc once stable.

mike_oncall: Closing active close-loop for now — mitigation in place, customer updated, handoff to night on-call @nina_oncall. Will create postmortem ticket in Jira (ISSUE-4556) and include runbook gap if needed.

incident-bot: Incident severity set to P1 at 1798888888. Ticket ISSUED-4556 created.
